info.title: JTest CLI Tool
info.description: Command-line interface for JTest - A universal JSON-based API testing framework. Provides tools for running, debugging, validating and exporting API tests defined in JSON format.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Prints help information
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES:
JTEST_CONFIG_FILE    Path to global JTest config file (JSON)

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Run test file(s) in debug mode (verbose) - supports wildcards

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --env-file
options.description: File path to environment variables

options.name: --env
options.description:
Environment variable formatted as key=value. You
can specify the option multiple times to define
multiple environment variables. Takes precedence
over --env-file

options.name: --globals-file
options.description: File path to global variables

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Run test files in parallel (default: 1)

options.name: --output
options.description:
Output folder for the report and trace when no
explicit --report/--trace path is given (default:
artifacts)

options.name: --categories
options.description:
Comma-separated list of test file categories to
run (default: all)

options.name: --skip-output
options.description:
Do not write the default report/trace files
(explicit --report/--trace are still written).
Default: false
'html' (default) or 'markdown'

options.name: --output-format
options.description:
Default report format when --report is not given:
'html' (default) or 'markdown'

options.name: --report
options.description: Write a report to the given file path (see

options.name: --report-format
options.description:
Format for --report: 'html' (default,
self-contained) or 'markdown'

options.name: --trace
options.description:
Write the canonical execution-trace JSON to the
given file path

options.name: --include-variables
options.description:
Include a masked dump of environment/global
variables in the report and trace (off by
default)
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES:
JTEST_CONFIG_FILE    Path to global JTest config file (JSON)

arguments.name: TEST_FILE_PATTERNS
arguments.description:
List of test file patterns that are executed in
order. Example: "tests/**/*"
"!tests/obsolete-tests/*"

karate'
